latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of text-to-video-making skill.
- Instantly convert written content (TXT, DOCX, PDF, SRT up to 200MB) into shareable AI-generated videos with visuals and voiceover.
- No video editing experience required; simply describe your desired output and receive a cloud-rendered MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- Seamless upload, export, and file compatibility with a variety of text, image, and audio formats.
- Ideal for marketers, content creators, and educators looking to quickly produce professional-looking videos.
